# Template: Default Project

> Generic project template. Asks 3 questions to set up project_info/.

## Questions

1. What language/runtime? (Python, Node.js, Rust, Go, Java, etc.)
2. What framework? (if any)
3. What's the project about? (CLI, API, web app, library, etc.)

## Generated Files

- `spec.md` — filled with project description + basic features
- `architecture.md` — single-module architecture placeholder
- `tech-stack.md` — language + package manager set from answers
- `environment.md` — appropriate venv/init commands for the language
